title: Bottom-Up and Top-Down Analysis of Values, Agendas, and Observations in Corpora and LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating socio-cultural value pluralism by extracting latent themes (observations, evaluations, agendas) from ethnographic interviews (e.g., maternal health practices in India) and using a top-down Natural Language Inference (NLI) approach to measure resonance and contradiction with different cultural stances.

Prompting LLMs to generate comments from opposing perspectives on polarizing policy topics (standardized testing and government regulation of business), then automatically extracting and analyzing the latent agendas, evaluations, and observations to measure the model's value alignment and ideological pluralism.
